asset.mark_source: CoinGecko live global volume-weighted AVAX/USD observed during run

signal_change.prior_regime_checkpoint: Avalanche DEX +46.8% 7d, perps +55.5% 7d, stablecoins about +2.9% 7d; leverage contamination prevented an entry.
signal_change.interpretation: The regime quality flipped materially from leverage-led/contaminated to spot-led: spot DEX growth accelerated sharply while perpetual volume moved negative, and stablecoin retention strengthened. This crosses the ecosystem alert threshold.

notes: Chain-level token incentives reported by DefiLlama are $0 over 24h, but that does not eliminate protocol-specific incentive contamination.

Aave is the largest Avalanche protocol at about $383.43M TVL and +37.24% over seven days, while Avalanche Foundation has committed up to $15M in milestone/KPI-linked incentives to bootstrap Aave V4 markets. That portion of TVL/lending growth is discounted.
Twenty-four-hour net inflow is positive but small relative to ecosystem size, so the strongest signal is retained stablecoins plus spot trading velocity rather than bridge inflow magnitude.
Avalanche RWA Active AUM is large, but no fresh independent acceleration in secondary RWA trading or collateralized borrowing was verified during this run.
OpenTrade RWA TVL is about $173.87M and -0.99% over seven days, which does not support treating rising chain RWA inventory as a new trading/utilization signal.
The planned dedicated Aave V4 RWA hub remains a prospective utilization catalyst rather than current confirmed usage.
The previously reported approximately 16,000 AVAX withdrawal from Binance remains the only recent directional whale item identified in this scan.
The wallet's historical selectivity, beneficial owner, repeat-buying behavior and independence were not verified.
Large exchange hot-wallet transfers are explicitly excluded from accumulation evidence. No new cohort of historically selective independent AVAX accumulators was verified.

catalyst.name: Helicon
notes: Official Avalanche Builder Hub documentation says Helicon is scheduled for Mainnet September 22, 2026 at 15:00 UTC and introduces Continuous Execution, auto-renewed staking, shorter minimum staking duration, dynamic minimum gas pricing and staking-economics changes.
The same official status table still displayed Mainnet as Scheduled when checked after the activation time. Successful activation is therefore not claimed until independently confirmed.
AVAX is the native gas/staking asset.
Official Avalanche documentation states Primary Network transaction fees are burned and AVAX has a 720M maximum supply, while validator rewards are minted and can offset burns.
AVAX is native, so third-party honeypot, removable-LP, arbitrary token-admin freeze and deployer-owned mint tests do not apply in the standard contract-token form.
CoinGecko reports market-cap/FDV about 0.94, reducing low-float dilution risk relative to many current candidates.
Ongoing validator reward issuance remains an economic dilution consideration even with the 720M hard cap.

liquidity_executability.notes: CoinGecko reports about $671.1M of 24h AVAX turnover across 124 exchanges and 239 markets; a normal paper starter would be trivially executable at modeled Tier A cost.

leadership_assessment: AVAX remains the cleanest liquid token exposure to the newly improving Avalanche chain regime, while protocol-level alternatives are either incentive-contaminated or have weaker direct linkage. The ecosystem signal is stronger than at the prior checkpoint, but the token is already up about 52.6% over seven days and selective-wallet confirmation is still missing.
portfolio_rationale: Two prior forward tests crossed decisively: stablecoin/DEX growth persisted and spot now outruns derivatives. However, the framework also required independent selective-wallet confirmation and cleaner attribution after protocol incentives; those conditions are not met. Chasing AVAX after a roughly 53% weekly move without the missing wallet leg would violate confirmation discipline.

broader_scan.sui: Spot velocity strengthened further, with 7d DEX growth around +101% and perps around +23.6%, but stablecoin growth faded to roughly +0.34%; retained-capital/selective-wallet confirmation remains insufficient.
broader_scan.polygon: DEX velocity remains extreme but stablecoin supply has turned negative over seven days and 24h inflows are negative; retained-capital confirmation deteriorated.
broader_scan.arbitrum: Stablecoin supply remains negative and perps growth materially outruns DEX growth; ARB also remains structurally rejected under the standing privileged-mint/upgrade gate.
broader_scan.plasma: Stablecoin and DEX acceleration remain strong at the chain level, but XPL remains structurally rejected under the standing supply/unlock gate.
broader_scan.solana: Prior spot-led regime persists, but no new selective-wallet confirmation justifies another add to an already approximately 10% paper position.
broader_scan.ethereum: Spot-led activity remains constructive, but seven-day stablecoin stock remains negative; existing core position is already near 19% of NAV.

major_uncertainties: Official Helicon documentation had not updated Mainnet status from Scheduled at the observation time.
Aave V4 growth cannot be cleanly separated from its up-to-$15M KPI-linked incentive package using the data available in this run.
No independently verified cohort of historically selective, independently funded AVAX spot accumulators has appeared.
RWA Active AUM is not evidence by itself of secondary turnover or collateral utilization.
forward_tests: Confirm successful Helicon mainnet activation from an authoritative operational source rather than inferred timing.
Require spot DEX growth to remain ahead of derivatives for multiple checkpoints while stablecoin supply remains positive.
Resolve how much of Aave TVL/borrow growth is incentive-driven versus organic after adjusting for the $15M KPI program.
Look for repeat AVAX spot accumulation by multiple historically selective, independently funded wallets with uncorrelated funding paths.
Treat new RWA issuance separately until secondary trading or collateralized borrowing becomes measurable.
